title: SMCare
description: Scenario Management is a specialist support provider based in Lancashire, serving areas including Blackpool, Wyre, Fylde, and Preston. The company offers 24-hour supported living and residential services, as well as short stay respite care for individuals with learning disabilities, complex needs, autism, and associated mental health issues. Their services are designed for those who may challenge services or have forensic backgrounds. Scenario Management aims to provide comprehensive support tailored to the needs of their clients.
